name: How do I choose between repairing my aging roof and replacing it?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between repairing my aging roof and replacing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision between repairing and replacing your aging roof often depends on the extent of damage, the roof's age, and your budget. Minor, isolated issues might warrant a repair, especially if the roof is still relatively young. However, widespread damage, recurring leaks, or a roof past its typical lifespan often make replacement the more cost-effective and long-term solution. A professional assessment will provide a clear recommendation based on these factors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose between repair and replacement based on damage extent, roof age, and budget. An assessment provides a recommendation.
